description: Canary pool construction and per-seed inclusion.

inclusion_probability.note: 00 §7.2: I_{j,s} ~ Bernoulli(0.5), re-drawn independently per seed.

generator_seed.note: The pool is built once and reused across seeds; only inclusion is re-drawn.

secret_length.note: 00 §7.1 requires a high-entropy secret without fixing its length; frozen before pool construction.

repetitions_per_canary.note: 00 §7.3: an included canary appears exactly once. Repetition is not offered under the sample-level DP arm.
